chat.greeting:
Hi! I'm an AI assistant. I know everything about the experience of {name}, {title}.

Ask me anything, tell me who you are looking for, or upload a vacancy and I'll estimate how well it matches.

input.attach: Attach a vacancy (PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT)

stub.reply: The AI assistant is almost ready: soon I'll answer questions like this one. Meanwhile, try the buttons above the input.

about.title: About this project
about.description: A CV of a fullstack engineer, made as a chat with an AI assistant that knows his experience.
about.how: Nuxt 4 with SSR, the Vercel AI SDK and models via OpenRouter. Besides text, the assistant answers with interactive blocks: CV sections, questions with options, a vacancy match report.
about.privacy: The chat history is stored only in your browser. The server receives only what is needed for an answer; uploaded files are not stored.
